title: Severin Coffee Maker Dead
fullDescription: Brewer doesn't respond. Often thermal cutout activated.

title: Descale Indicator
fullDescription: Severin signals descale needed via flashing light.

title: Water Leaking
fullDescription: Tank seal cracked or hose loose.

title: Filter Overflows
fullDescription: Fine grind or wrong filter size causes overflow.

title: Clock Resets After Unplug
fullDescription: Severin programmable models lose clock if unplugged. By design.

title: Auto-Brew Not Triggering
fullDescription: Auto button not active or time set wrong (AM/PM).

title: Hotplate Auto-Off Too Soon
fullDescription: EU regulation requires auto-off. By design.

title: Coffee Tastes Off
fullDescription: Mineral/coffee oil residue. Run cleaning cycle.

title: Pause-and-Pour Sticks
fullDescription: Drip-stop valve under brew basket sticky.
